family. Parents, children and relatives as a group.
single. Only one, with no brothers or sisters.
daughter. Someone's female child.
strict. Making sure people follow the rules.
visit. To go to see someone and spend time with them.
curfew. A time when you must be back home.
spank. To hit a child with an open hand as punishment.
housework. Work like cleaning, cooking and washing at home.
jealous. Unhappy because someone has what you want.
liberty. The freedom to choose how you live.
Coordinating conjunctions join two equal parts of a sentence.
